# SMBAct window actions

58 actions. **MCP**: the tool that runs it (`window_action` takes the id as `action`; the `hide-*` ones are `minimize_all` with a `display`). **CLI**: `run` = `smbact-cli run <id>`, `special` = also through `run`, `minimize-all` = that subcommand, — = not in the CLI. **Cycle**: repeated presses of the hotkey or `smbact-cli run <id>` without `--window-id` on the same window within 2 s step through this chain; MCP `window_action` never cycles.

| Action | Category | What | Platforms | MCP | CLI | Cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `left-half` | halves | left 1/2 | all | window_action | run | left-half → first-two-thirds → first-three-fourths → first-third → first-fourth |
| `right-half` | halves | right 1/2 | all | window_action | run | right-half → last-two-thirds → last-three-fourths → last-third → last-fourth |
| `top-half` | halves | top 1/2 | all | window_action | run | — |
| `bottom-half` | halves | bottom 1/2 | all | window_action | run | — |
| `center-half` | halves | middle 1/2, full height | all | window_action | run | — |

| `center-third` | thirds | middle 1/3 | all | window_action | run | center-third → first-third → last-third |
| `last-third` | thirds | right 1/3 | all | window_action | run | last-third → center-third → first-third |
